card.name: Verbs of adding or creating something new
card.fires_on: Verbs like added, adds, add and created when something new is introduced, such as a feature, rule, office or building. Seen in changelogs, histories and descriptions of laws or projects.

modes.label: Changelog entries
modes.description: The word Added starting or following a patch or version note.

modes.label: History or legal additions
modes.description: A verb of adding or creating in text about institutions, bills or construction.
modes.example: The Secretary of the Treasury oversaw it from 1882 to 1891 when the Superintendent of Immigration office was<< created>> within the Treasury Department.

card.writes: No clear effect from the promoted tokens, which are mixed and unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on words meaning something new was added or created, like in update notes or histories.
